title: Eggplant Stir Fry with Pasta
description: A delicious and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry made with eggplant and pasta. This dish is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add eggplant and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add pasta to the skillet and stir to combine with eggplant.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until pasta is heated through.
Season with soy sauce to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
